description: Alternative Fuel Locations is a dataset listed in City of Chicago open data portal (data.cityofchicago.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Chicago. List of locations in NE Illinois, NW Indiana, and SE Wisconsin where alternative vehicle fuels are available. For a Chicago-only filtered view, see For more detailed descriptions of fields, see. Coverage: Chicago. The portal files it under the category Environment & Sustainable Development. Its tags are transportation, sustainability. The table has 48 columns. Attribution on the portal: U.S. Department of Energy. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofchicago-org-portal.
